sections.shortTitle: Sindh Regularization of Contingent Paid or Work-Charged Employees of Left Bank Outfall Drainage Lbod Act 2018
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XL OF 2018
ACT XL OF 2018
SINDH (REGULARIZATION OF CONTINGENT PAID OR
WORK-CHARGED EMPLOYEES OF LEFT BANK OUTFALL
DRAINAGE (LBOD) ACT, 2018
An Act to provide for regularization of the services of employees
appointed on contingent or work-charged basis in the Left Bank Outfall Drainage
(LBOD) of Irrigation Department of Government of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 30th May, 2018]
NO.PAS/LEGIS-B-24/2018,
dated 30.5.2018.---The Sindh Regularization of Contingent Paid or Work-Charged
Employees of Left Bank Outfall Drainage (LBOD) Bill, 2018 having been passed by
the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 09th May, 2018 and assented to by the
Governor of Sindh on 23rd May, 2018 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to be provide for
regularization of the services of employees appointed on contingent or
work-charged basis in the Left Bank Outfall Drainage (LBOD) of Irrigation
Department of Government of Sindh, and to provide for matters connected
therewith or ancillary thereto;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Sindh (Regularization of Contingent Paid or Work-Charged
Employees of Left Bank Outfall Drainage (LBOD) Act, 2018.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

2. Definitions.---(1) In this Act, unless context otherwise
requires -
(a) "Act"
means the Sindh Civil Servants Act,1973;
(b) "appointment"
means the appointment of a duly qualified employee made on contingent paid or
work-charged basis;
(c) "civil
servant" shall have the same meaning as assigned to it in the Act;
(d) "employee"
means a person appointed on contingent paid or work-charged basis in basic pay
scale 1 to 11, in the Left Bank Outfall Drainage (LBOD) of Irrigation
Department of Government;
(e) "Government"
means the Government of Sindh;
(f) "post"
means a post held by an employee;

sections.description:
Regularization of services of contingent paid and work-charged employees

ACT XL OF 2018
ACT XL OF 2018
SINDH (REGULARIZATION OF CONTINGENT PAID OR
WORK-CHARGED EMPLOYEES OF LEFT BANK OUTFALL
DRAINAGE (LBOD) ACT, 2018
An Act to provide for regularization of the services of employees
appointed on contingent or work-charged basis in the Left Bank Outfall Drainage
(LBOD) of Irrigation Department of Government of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 30th May, 2018]
NO.PAS/LEGIS-B-24/2018,
dated 30.5.2018.---The Sindh Regularization of Contingent Paid or Work-Charged
Employees of Left Bank Outfall Drainage (LBOD) Bill, 2018 having been passed by
the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 09th May, 2018 and assented to by the
Governor of Sindh on 23rd May, 2018 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to be provide for
regularization of the services of employees appointed on contingent or
work-charged basis in the Left Bank Outfall Drainage (LBOD) of Irrigation
Department of Government of Sindh, and to provide for matters connected
therewith or ancillary thereto;
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
3. Regularization
of services of contingent paid and work-charged employees.---(1) Notwithstanding anything contained in the
Act or rules made thereunder or any decree, order or judgment of a court, but
subject to other provisions of this Act, an employee appointed on contingent
paid or work-charged basis or who is otherwise eligible for appointment on such
post and holding such appointment, immediately before the commencement of this
Act, shall be deemed to have been validly appointed as a civil servant on
regular basis, with effect from the date of commencement of this Act.
(2) The
orders of regularization under subsection (1) shall not be made unless
antecedents of such employee with regard to his academic qualifications,
experience, age and place of domicile are scrutinized and cleared by the
Special Committee.
(3) The
Special Committee under subsection (2) shall be headed by the Secretary of the
Irrigation Department and three other members, two from Irrigation Department
to be nominated by the Secretary Irrigation Department and one from the
Services Wing of the Services and General Administration Department.
